teaser: The smell of a diesel engine idling outside a loading dock is the kind of thing you notice before anyone else does, and that noticing says something about carrying life path 5 as an ESTJ. The 5 wants the next route, the next version of the plan, the next town on the map. The ESTJ in you wants the plan written down, timed, and followed by everyone standing near it. Most days those two impulses trade the wheel without much friction. The friction shows only when the plan becomes the thing standing between you and the exit.
excerpt: Who finishes setting up the tent first, you or the person already sitting by the fire?
